messages.content: Find a picnic spot in Miami.

function.name: local_fauna

message.content: Sure! If you’re looking for a great place to have a picnic in Miami, I’d recommend **South Pointe Park**. It’s located at 1 Biscayne Blvd, Miami Beach, FL 33139 and offers beautiful views of the ocean, plenty of shaded areas, and easy access to the beach. You’ll also find nearby cafés and restaurants if you want to grab some snacks or drinks afterward. Enjoy your time out there!
